title: Health
description: A device's answer to GET <baseUrl>/v1/health: its word on its health, its ID and its capabilities. A device may send fields this schema does not know.

status.description: Usually ok, degraded, starting or updating. A device that sends another word still answers.

protocols.description: The protocols it serves diagnostics in, in its order of preference. Empty when it serves none.

checksumAlgorithm.description: The algorithm of the checksum it reports with its diagnostics, such as sha256.
